notes: Vine is the west edge (only stubs of the cross streets west of Vine are drawn), Main the east edge. East 15th is printed '15TH (MARY)' and East 14th 'E. 14TH (ALLISON)'. West of Vine the streets printed '15TH ST.' (y~2267) and '14TH ST.' (y~3752) meet Vine ~300 and ~440 px south of East 15th and East 14th, so they are separate T points named West 15th / West 14th Street. Liberty runs diagonally (WNW-ESE); it is printed 40' near Vine but '33'' near Main; west of Vine its north line is ~24 px further north than east of Vine (crossing centre is the average of the four corners). Walnut north of Liberty is ~20 px east of Walnut south of Liberty; Main north of Liberty is ~30 px east of Main south of Liberty, and an 8 in. water pipe angles NNE out of the Main/Liberty crossing (Main appears to bend there; continues on sheet 155). East 14th printed '32'' (or 3 1/2) near Vine and '33'' near Main. Melindy runs only Clay to Main. Seegar Alley is printed 'SEEGAR ALLEY' here; the same alley is printed 'S. SEEGER' on sheet 145. Boots Alley and Seegar Alley continue south of Mercer onto sheet 145, so those are crosses. The parallel double lines in the top-right corner (north of Liberty, east of Clay) are on sheet 155 territory (incline/rail) and were ignored. Sheet is slightly skewed: Walnut centre drifts from ~2055 at 15th to ~2075 at Mercer. Moore Street is offset at Liberty: the Moore north of Liberty (155 outline gap with pipe) meets Liberty ~160 px (47 ft) west of the Moore south of Liberty, so there are two Moore/Liberty T points, (1082,905) and (1244,950).
